caption:
After 40 years building his career in US medicine, he's coming back to build India's newest medical school.

Prof. Anil K. Lalwani, a Professor of Otolaryngology and Vice Chair for Research at Columbia University, was appointed inaugural Dean of IIT Kanpur's new Gangwal School of Medical Sciences and Technology in April 2026. He trained at University of Michigan, Duke and UCSF, chaired NYU's Otolaryngology department, and has authored over 275 peer-reviewed papers pioneering gene-transfer technology for inner-ear disease. The school he's now building, funded by fellow diaspora figure Rakesh Gangwal's Rs 400 crore gift, aims to fuse engineering and medicine from the ground up.

One diaspora figure funded the building. Another is now building what happens inside it.

Sources: IIT Kanpur, BioSpectrum India (2026)
